kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts (4 patterns, 4 traps, 3 pivots).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the rule, the two equilibria with examples and treatments, the pKa definition, the figure, the TCA line, and the dosage equations; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The three-gate reading protocol (GATE 1 CLASSIFY the drug as weak acid or weak base; GATE 2 COUNT THE CHARGE at the tubular pH — ionized = trapped and cleared, neutral = reabsorbed; GATE 3 MOVE the urine pH toward the ionized side) plus the two-exception frame (the TCA cardiac-not-renal bicarbonate; loading-Vd vs maintenance-CL in organ disease) — KYP's synthesis of the page into one algorithm.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the rule, the classes, and the equations as separate fragments; the gate protocol, the exception pairing, and the fill-the-container/match-the-drain framing of the dosage equations are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + blocks[3] the steps block + pivots + the visual's Band 1/4 spine

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (CHARGED TRAPPED, NEUTRAL RETURNED / BICARB TRAPS ACIDS, AMMONIUM TRAPS BASES / AT THE pKa, 50/50 — ACIDS UP, BASES DOWN / LOAD WITH Vd, MAINTAIN WITH CL) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 231 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics + the visual's card footers + rapidReview.m3

kypExtensions.summary: The salicylate-overdose miniCase (a CKD-stage-4 patient whose renal-elimination maneuver [bicarbonate to trap RCOO–] is paired with the dosing adjustment [maintenance ↓, loading usually unchanged], with the ammonium-chloride wrong-direction, the TCA sodium-channel confusion, the steady-state conflation, and the acidify-plus-shrink-both-doses distractors) — a KYP-authored integration of the trapping rule and both dosage rules.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the urine-pH block and the dosage block side by side but never asks the learner to pair them; the vignette, the four distractors, and the two-layer question are KYP's design.
